operation.source_intent: Go from current WordPress users page to previous page only when page > 1, re-reading authoritative site users.

laravel_runtime.semantics: Previous button bound to distinct global users operation and previous-page state transition, with busy and boundary protection; query state changes trigger tenant/site-scoped native WordPress REST GET. Laravel returns remote authoritative result or permission failure; no fake success.
laravel_runtime.loading_error_empty_behavior: Disable previous on page one and while fetching. Permission failures surface query error; missing rows remain empty.

coverage: exact operation ID and Razor PreviousAsync contract
real page two to page one WordPress GET
previous disabled on first page and during loading
foreign tenant direct ID 404 before remote read

provenance.note: Acceptance and exact-head CI must pass before official generator enrollment and terminality are asserted.
